request: At DeleteSpaceMember handler entry, compare removal of the caller's own active membership with removal of a different active member's membership in the same space. Assume resource resolution succeeds. Report source-visible authorization and the accepted-policy comparison separately.

rule.text: An active space member may delete their own membership to leave. Removing a different active member requires space administrator authority.

analysisContract.publicInstruction: Use exact declared premises and accepted policy. Trace decisive control and effect, distinguish unspecified from absent, and answer requested branches without inventing runtime facts.

premises.statement: At handler entry, the active ordinary non-administrator caller targets their own active membership in the selected space, and resolveSpaceMemberResource succeeds.

requiredResponseDetails: Report source behavior and policy comparison separately; source-external store failure is not authorization.

premises.statement: At handler entry, the active ordinary non-administrator caller targets a different active member in the same space, and resolveSpaceMemberResource succeeds.

requiredResponseDetails: Report source behavior and policy comparison separately; source-external store failure is not authorization.
